etymology: a primitive root [perhaps rather the same as 04184 through the idea of receding by contact]
avSummary: depart 11, remove 6, take away 1, gone back 1, cease 1, variant 1
definition:
1) to depart, remove
    1a) (Qal)
        1a1) to depart
        1a2) to remove
        1a3) to be removed (of inanimate objects)
    1b) (Hiphil) to remove, depart
